name: Replicate MCP
tagline: Run any open-source ML model via Replicate's cloud API from your agent.
shortDescription: The official Replicate MCP server. Lets your agent run any model in Replicate's catalog — image generation (Stable Diffusion, FLUX), LLMs, audio, video, embeddings — via a unified API. Pay per second of compute.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Replicate MCP server, by Replicate. Exposes Replicate's prediction API as MCP tools: list models, run predictions, get outputs, stream results. Replicate hosts thousands of community models with a unified API.

## Why we recommend it

The cleanest way to give your agent access to any open-source ML model without managing GPU infrastructure. Image generation, LLMs, audio, video, embeddings — if it's on Replicate, your agent can call it. Pay per second of compute, so it's cheap for small workloads.

## When to use it

- Image generation agents: Stable Diffusion, FLUX, SDXL
- Audio agents: Whisper transcription, music generation, voice cloning
- Video agents: text-to-video, image-to-video models
- Custom LLM hosting: run any open-source model with one API
installInstructions:
1. Get an API token at https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens
2. Set `REPLICATE_API_TOKEN=...`
3. `uvx mcp-server-replicate`

**Pricing note:** Replicate charges per second of GPU time, varies by model. Image models: ~$0.01-0.05 per image. LLMs: ~$0.001-0.05 per second.
pricingDetails: Free. Replicate: $5 free credit for new accounts, then pay-as-you-go per second.
